name: Matilde Carmela Emanuela Cavagnaro — husband Pietro Dondero and a daughter born 1883 at Genova
researcher_question: Was the Carmela Cavagnaro who bore a daughter, Maria Clementina Angelica Gentile Dondero, at Genova on 30 August 1883 with Pietro Dondero the same woman as Matilde Carmela Emanuela Cavagnaro, born 1866 in Lima?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 21, hint-samples.csv row 640, flags adds_spouse/adds_daughter, confidence 3). Adjudicated as a FALSE MATCH (spec 3.6 outcome (c)). The subject's own documented marriage is to Paolo Andrea Vaglio, 26 Jul 1900 at Bogliasco (ark:/61903/1:1:X3L8-MFLR); read directly, that act names the bride born 1866 at Lima, Maestra Elementare, daughter of Giuseppe and Maddalena Bitano, which identifies G4Z4-RJ1. The Carmela Cavagnaro of the 1883 hint entry (ark:/61903/1:1:6BHW-1HG3) is a different woman, documented with Pietro Dondero at Genova in at least 1883 and 1891 (Attilio Omero Dondero, 31 May 1891, ark:/61903/1:1:X3TM-QPSS). Caveat for graders: the 1900 marriage post-dates both Dondero births and the indexed act carries no stato civile, so it does not on its own exclude an earlier marriage; reading the bride's civil status off the register image (ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-L9WL-JC3N) would close that gap and was not done. No substitute husband or child was found for the subject. Her birth is about 10 May 1866 at Lima (baptised 21 May 1866 aged eleven days, Parish of Sant'Anna, Lima), making her 17 in Aug 1883. There is no birthplace conflict: ark:/61903/1:1:QVR6-Q9DC indexes a birth of 20 May 1866 at San Rocco Sopra Principe, Genova, but the entry is an 1877 transcription of a Lima baptism (its DigitalArtifact coverage is 1877/1877), so Genova is where the paperwork was filed. What the 20 May date itself refers to is NOT established - it is the date the entry carries, not a filing date, but it is one day before the 21 May baptism; see the README. The age answer is 17 on either reading. Her parents are Giuseppe Cavagnaro and Maddalena Boitano; Angelo Vaglio and Maria Fereccio are the GROOM's parents, attached to her in error from her own marriage record, and of the three 'Vaglio' sources two (7PM9-ZQP, 7PM9-W4L) are her own personas on that act and belong on her, while 7PM9-W5S is Paolo's persona and does not. Corrected on the live tree 2026-09-29 (issue #2908) — three parent edges removed and the birth date fixed; the committed snapshot deliberately still carries the old state and must not be re-snapshotted. OPEN QUESTION, no ruling yet: source 7PM9-W5S (ark:/61903/1:1:X3G7-XG52, Paolo's own persona) is still attached, asserting she is him. Outside the authorised scope, which was set before the second opinion found it. Issue #2908 is closed, so it is recorded in the README instead. Second opinion: Ikennaya Mbadiwe. The batch CSV labels this row Peru; the records are Genovese and the fixture is tagged IT.
